skills.name: gmail_search
skills.description: Search the connected Gmail account using Gmail query syntax.

skills.name: gmail_read
skills.description: Read one Gmail message by ID.

skills.name: gmail_create_draft
skills.description: Create a Gmail draft without sending it.

skills.name: gmail_send_draft
skills.description: Send an existing Gmail draft by ID.

skills.name: gmail_list_labels
skills.description: List Gmail labels in the connected account.

skills.name: calendar_list_events
skills.description: List upcoming events from Google Calendar.

skills.name: calendar_get_event
skills.description: Read one Google Calendar event.

skills.name: calendar_create_event
skills.description: Create a timed Calendar event when requested. For exact-time tasks use this rather than Google Tasks. Call calendar_current_time for relative dates. Default IST. Confirm ambiguity; report returned date/time and timezone.

start_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

end_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone; defaults to Asia/Kolkata (IST). Use local wall-clock datetimes, not incorrectly Z-tagged IST times.

recurrence_rule.description: One RRULE such as RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=4. Empty string removes recurrence on update. Only use when requested.

reminder_minutes.description: Popup minutes before the event; 0 means at start, -1 disables reminders. Omit to retain calendar defaults.

skills.name: calendar_list_calendars
skills.description: List connected Google Calendars.

skills.name: calendar_create_calendar
skills.description: Create a secondary Google Calendar with an explicit name. Do not create duplicates without confirmation.

skills.name: calendar_delete_calendar
skills.description: Delete an explicitly identified secondary calendar. Never delete the primary calendar; list calendars first when the ID is uncertain.

skills.name: calendar_add_attachment
skills.description: Attach an http(s) file URL to an explicitly identified event. Read the event first and confirm before changing it.

skills.name: calendar_current_time
skills.description: Get fresh current date, weekday, time and UTC offset. Call before resolving today, tomorrow, now, or in N minutes; default is IST.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone; defaults to Asia/Kolkata (IST). Use local wall-clock datetimes, not incorrectly Z-tagged IST times.

skills.name: calendar_update_event
skills.description: Edit or reschedule an explicitly identified event after a user request. List/read first to obtain its ID; ask if multiple matches. Supply both start and end for rescheduling. Preserve duration unless changed. For a recurring series use its master ID only if the user requests the whole series. Attachments are comma-separated Google Drive or public file URLs.

start_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

end_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone; defaults to Asia/Kolkata (IST). Use local wall-clock datetimes, not incorrectly Z-tagged IST times.

recurrence_rule.description: One RRULE such as RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=4. Empty string removes recurrence on update. Only use when requested.

reminder_minutes.description: Popup minutes before the event; 0 means at start, -1 disables reminders. Omit to retain calendar defaults.

attachments.description: Comma-separated http(s) file URLs to attach.

skills.name: calendar_delete_event
skills.description: Delete only the event the user requests. List/read first to find its exact ID, date and time; ask when ambiguous. A recurring master ID deletes its series: use it only for an explicit whole-series request. Do not delete by title alone.

skills.name: calendar_check_availability
skills.description: Check busy intervals in a requested time window before scheduling. Uses IST unless another zone is explicit. Failure does not mean free.

start_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

end_datetime.description: ISO date/time in the requested timezone, e.g. 2026-10-26T15:00:00+05:30 for 3 PM IST. Never attach Z to an IST wall time.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone; defaults to Asia/Kolkata (IST). Use local wall-clock datetimes, not incorrectly Z-tagged IST times.

skills.name: tasks_list_lists
skills.description: List Google Task lists.

skills.name: tasks_list_tasks
skills.description: List Google Tasks. Omit list_id to use the first available task list; call tasks_list_lists to choose another.

skills.name: tasks_create_task
skills.description: Create an untimed Google Task. This tool cannot schedule a task at an exact hour. For requests with a specific time use calendar_create_event and clarify duration if needed.

skills.name: tasks_complete_task
skills.description: Complete a Google Task by ID in the first available list unless list_id is provided.

skills.name: drive_search_files
skills.description: Search or list files in the connected Google Drive by name or content phrase. Omit query to list recent files. If permission is missing, call google_authorize.

skills.name: drive_get_file
skills.description: Read metadata for one Google Drive file by its ID.

skills.name: drive_read_text_file
skills.description: Read a small uploaded text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, or XML file from Drive. For native Google Docs or Sheets use their dedicated read tools.

skills.name: docs_read_document
skills.description: Read text from a Google Docs document, including its tabs and tables, by document ID.

skills.name: sheets_get_spreadsheet
skills.description: List titles and sizes of tabs in a Google Sheets spreadsheet by ID.

skills.name: sheets_read_range
skills.description: Read a bounded cell range from Google Sheets. Call sheets_get_spreadsheet first if you need a tab name. Omit cell_range for the first 25 rows and 10 columns.

cell_range.description: A1 range such as Sheet1!A1:J25, at most 100 rows and 20 columns

skills.name: google_authorize
skills.description: Open Google account OAuth authorization in the default web browser to connect or reconnect Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, and read-only Drive, Docs, and Sheets. Call when the user asks to connect or a Google read tool reports setup_required.

skills.name: google_connection_status
skills.description: Check whether Google Workspace is connected and whether Drive, Docs, and Sheets read permission is granted.
